meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 装好后，Claude会安装OneCLI工具和网关，把.env里的Anthropic等密钥搬进Agent Vault保险库，然后重建并重启服务；之后密钥由网关注入，容器内看不到原始密钥。
howto.when: 在/update-nanoclaw把OneCLI作为破坏性变更引入后，或首次从头搭建OneCLI时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化OneCLI，把.env的密钥迁移到Agent Vault
我刚更新了NanoClaw，请配置OneCLI Agent Vault
say.note: 它会检查并完成初始化
将安装网关并迁移凭据

howto.what_en: Installs the OneCLI CLI and gateway, migrates your .env credentials (e.g., Anthropic keys) into the Agent Vault, then rebuilds and restarts the service. Secrets are injected via the gateway, so containers never see raw keys.
howto.when_en: Triggers after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when setting up OneCLI from scratch for the first time.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate my .env keys to Agent Vault
say_en.note: Claude will start installation and migration

say_en.text: I just updated NanoClaw, please configure OneCLI Agent Vault
say_en.note: It will check and finish initialization

say_en.text: First-time OneCLI setup, please run init-onecli
say_en.note: It will install the gateway and migrate credentials
